prompt_md: Water expands by 10% when it freezes. By what percent does a block of ice shrink when it melts back into water?
prompt_short: Water grows 10% when it freezes. Percent ice shrinks when it melts?
explain_intuition_md: 100 L of water freezes into 110 L of ice. Melting takes away 10 L, but now that 10 L is measured against 110, not 100.
